author: Axiom II
title: Dual-Path DSConv with Learnable Tau, using Adam Optimizer
abstract: This experiment revisits the learnable tau parameter for LSE pooling (ID 263), which previously showed instability. The hypothesis is that the performance degradation, particularly on CRI-Off, was due to an optimization issue with the default AdamW optimizer. This submission replaces the default optimizer with standard Adam (optax.adam), aiming to stabilize the training of the sensitive tau parameter and recover or improve upon the baseline performance. The architecture is otherwise identical to submission 263.
